notes.title: Meet & Chat with the Pillowheads Dev Team
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

We would like to invite you to a quick Dev Chat session at our Discord server. 
It will take place on Friday, June 19th, from 8 - 9 pm CEST. 

Just join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/sQ5Y2R7]Pillowheads Discord server[/url][/b] to participate.

We hope you will enjoy the Steam Game Festival and wish you a lot of fun! 

[i]- Your Pillowheads Dev Team[/i]

notes.title: Your invitation for "Pillowheads: It's Party Time"
notes.content:
[i][b]Choose your Pillowhead... [/b][/i]
[i][h3][b]Sharpen your pencils... [/b][/h3][/i]
[i][h2][b]Get ready for the party![/b][/h2][/i]

The demo of Pillowheads will allow you to play unlimited sessions of [b]Last Man Standing[/b], a game mode where the [b]last Pillowhead remaining[/b] on the field will win. 
[b]But be warned[/b]: Defeated players can return if they [b]successfully sabotage[/b] you from outside.

Enjoy the [b]cheerful and colorful crafted Grassland[/b] where the sun always shows up to your party. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37956554/842074bcb5e1bf7e2a5b4f55692119e1cba5f042.gif[/img]


Up to 4 player can compete [u][b]locally[/b][/u] or via [u][b]Remote Play Together[/b][/u] against each other (or play against [u][b]bots to practice[/b][/u] for the next party.)

This demo is only showing a small slice of the game. 
Be prepared for [b]more game modes[/b], [b]more maps[/b] and [b]modificators[/b] which add variety by changing game rules. 
[b][i]Visit our Store Page to find more information about the full game features![/i][/b]


We hope you will enjoy our game and wish you a lot of fun! 
[b][i]- Your Pillowheads Dev Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: Pillowheads at the Steam Game Festival 2020 Summer Edition
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

We are very excited to be part of the Steam Game Festival starting on June 16th 2020! 

Get a chance to have a first look at Pillowheads with the demo:

Play unlimited sessions of the [b]Last Man Standing[/b] game mode on our wonderful map [b]Grassland[/b]! 

Up to 4 player can compete [u]locally[/u] or via [u]Remote Play Together[/u] (or play against [u]bots[/u] to practice for the next party!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37956554/01f7dac300ba4d019374b7b6fef2db26970f5659.jpg[/img]


We hope you will enjoy the game and have a lot of fun! 

[i]- Your Pillowheads Dev Team[/i]



[i]Feel free to join the Pillowheads Discord server: [/i]https://discord.gg/sQ5Y2R7
